# pixel width

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pixelWidth`](gmeow-pixelWidth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pixelWidth>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
